_readme: The bodywork gallery. This file and gallerygen.py live inside the repo on purpose: the gallery was once rebuilt from scratch because the build data lived outside it. A PAIR entry has 'before' and 'after' and renders as a drag slider; labelBefore/labelAfter say honestly what the two sides are, so do not write 'Before'/'After' unless the left side really is the damage. A SINGLE entry has 'image' and renders as a plain photo. 'type' drives the filter buttons, space separated. 'price' is shown to customers as a real figure, so leave it empty rather than guessing.

items.title: Vauxhall Insignia, front end resprayed
items.note: Front wing and bumper off, prepared and masked, then refinished in the car's own metallic red. Drag the handle to see it come back together.

items.title: The same car, masked and finished
items.note: Masked to the panel edges so the new paint meets the old cleanly, and the finish afterwards.

items.title: Refitting the front bumper
items.note: Back on the car once the paint had hardened, lined up to the wing and bonnet gaps.

items.title: Wing and headlight, finished
items.note: The repaired wing back on the car, gaps set and the paint matched into the door.

items.title: Headlight and grille back in
items.note: Everything refitted. Shut lines and gaps are the part people notice afterwards.

items.title: Metallic red, close up
items.note: The finish where the new paint meets the original on the bonnet shut line.

items.title: Flatting a van door by hand
items.note: Most of a good paint job is what happens before any paint goes on. This is the stage nobody sees.

items.title: Van masked up in the booth
items.note: Our own spray booth, so the work is not sent out and the vehicle is not sitting somewhere else for a week.

items.title: Masked to the shut lines
items.note: Masked to the edges of the panel so the repair blends in rather than stopping at a hard line.

items.title: Laying down colour
items.note: Mixed to the car's own paint code and sprayed in the booth, in full air-fed kit.

items.title: Colour going on
items.note: Even coats, wet edge kept, no dry spray at the edges of the panel.

items.title: Masked and ready
items.note: Wheels, glass and trim covered before anything is sprayed.

items.title: Door and wing prepared
items.note: Edges taped and the surrounding panels protected before the gun comes out.

items.title: Gearbox out on the ramp
items.note: Bodywork is not all we do. Mechanical repairs happen in the same building, so a car needing both does not go to two places.
